usageNote: 名词短语，说生活方式用这个超高级！比'healthy life'听起来更有活力感，适合文章标题或朋友圈文案😄

examples.en: She embraces fresh and healthy living by eating organic food and exercising daily.
examples.zh: 她通过吃有机食品和每天锻炼来践行清新健康的生活方式。

examples.en: Fresh and healthy living doesn't have to be expensive — just start with small habits.
examples.zh: 清新健康的生活不必花很多钱——从小习惯开始就好。
